query:
INSERT INTO feeds (
            url,
            feed_type,
            hub_url,
            topic,
            lease_expires_at,
            interval_secs,
            last_polled_at
        )
        VALUES ($1, $2::feed_type, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7)
        ON CONFLICT (url) DO UPDATE SET
            feed_type = EXCLUDED.feed_type,
            hub_url = EXCLUDED.hub_url,
            topic = EXCLUDED.topic,
            interval_secs = EXCLUDED.interval_secs
        RETURNING id
